'use strict'; /** A demo class. */ @sealed export default class Demo<T extends object> implements Runnable { private readonly count: number = 42; protected items: string[] = []; constructor(public name: string, private config: Config = {}) { super(); } async run(items?: T[]): Promise<void> { const ratio: number = 1.5e-3; const re: RegExp = /[a-z]+/gi; const label: string = `demo ${this.name}`; const obj: Config = { name: 'pier', count: this.count }; if (this.count > 0 && items?.length) { console.log(label, obj, ratio, re); } return <div className="box">{this.name}</div>; } } namespace Demo.Utils { export function helper(a: number, b: number): number { return a * b; } } interface Config { name?: string; count?: number; } type Alias = Config | null; enum Color { Red, Green, Blue } const fn: (x: number) => number = (x) => x;
